global_skip_policy: A skipped state or state requirement always creates an effective ENT_EXCEPTION_RECORD identifying scope, rationale, effect, expiry if temporary, and approving ENT_APPROVAL_RECORD. A skip never waives downstream completion predicates unless explicitly stated.
global_backtrack_policy: Backtracking changes only ENT_DEAL.current_state and active workstream status. Historical evidence, analytical versions, decisions, approvals, documents, and outcomes remain immutable. Downstream current objects are marked stale and recomputed through successor versions.
global_revival_policy: Revival requires new material evidence, access, terms, process, or authority and a successor effective decision. The original terminated or closed cycle remains immutable.
implementation_invariants: ENT_DEAL.current_state is the sole authoritative primary-state field; documents do not set state.
A transition is atomic: guards, gate, authority, permission, and materiality succeed before current_state changes.
No waiver, approval, risk acceptance, permission, or condition satisfaction is inferred from silence.
Every skip, backtrack, retry, revival, and transition attempt produces an append-only audit event; ENT_WORKFLOW_EVENT provides the persistent object.
Historical effective decisions, approvals, model cases, valuation cases, signed sets, closing records, positions, monitoring records, and outcomes are never overwritten.
Changed upstream analytical objects propagate staleness through explicit lineage; ENT_STALENESS_RECORD provides the persistent staleness object.
Permission answers whether an actor may act on an object; authority answers whether an actor may approve, waive, accept risk, commit, sign, close, sell, impair, or override.
Materiality result controls engine consequence: inform, warn, block, trigger, reopen, or permit.
A conditional approval or close condition is explicit and owned; ENT_CONDITION_RECORD provides the condition lifecycle.
Parallel workstreams may start when node start predicates are satisfied, but final output cannot pass an unsatisfied blocking edge.
A live or residual exposure cannot enter permanent termination or closed archive without monitoring or outcome treatment.
Archetype extensions activate only when ENT_DEAL.archetype and their activation condition are both true.
versioning_invariant: Analytical revisions create successor objects; decisions and authority records retain immutable references to the exact versions used at the time.
